# PipsPager

Header: `winui/ui/navigation/PipsPager.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/navigation/PipsPager.hpp`.

A strip of small dots, one per page, for paging through a large item set such as a [`Carousel`](carousel.md#uicarousel)'s pictures.

The selected page's dot is drawn larger, in the same color. Optional previous/next buttons flank the strip and hide at their own end of the range unless `PipsPagerWrapMode::Wrap`. At most [`max_visible_pips()`](#max_visible_pips) dots are shown, and the shown range follows the selection. With [`number_of_pages()`](#number_of_pages) unset (the default) the page count is open-ended, and the list grows by one whenever the selection reaches its last pip. The whole strip is a single tab stop. The arrow keys along its axis step the selection, and Home/End jump to the ends. Hover never changes its measured size. [`ui::PipsPager`](#uipipspager) is the declarative form.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::size_t> page{0};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 12,
    .content  = {
        ui::Text{.text = ui::bind(page, [](std::size_t p) { return std::format("Page {}", p + 1); })},
        ui::PipsPager{
            .selected_index             = page,
            .number_of_pages            = 8,
            .previous_button_visibility = ui::PipsPagerButtonVisibility::VisibleOnPointerOver,
            .next_button_visibility     = ui::PipsPagerButtonVisibility::VisibleOnPointerOver,
        },
    },
});

// Imperatively:
auto pager = std::make_unique<ui::PipsPagerControl>(/*number_of_pages=*/10);
pager->set_orientation(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
pager->set_wrap_mode(ui::PipsPagerWrapMode::Wrap);
pager->on_selection_changed([](std::size_t index) { /* show page `index` */ });
```

## `ui::PipsPager`

A row of page dots. Builds a [ui::PipsPagerControl](#uipipspagercontrol).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::size_t> picture{0};

window.set_content(ui::PipsPager{
    .selected_index             = picture,
    .number_of_pages            = 8,
    .previous_button_visibility = ui::PipsPagerButtonVisibility::VisibleOnPointerOver,
    .next_button_visibility     = ui::PipsPagerButtonVisibility::VisibleOnPointerOver,
    .horizontal_alignment       = ui::Alignment::Center,
});
```

```cpp
    .previous_button_visibility, .next_button_visibility, .wrap_mode, .style, .margin, .width,
    .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility, .on_selection_changed,
    .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down,
    .on_wheel, .control
}
```

### number_of_pages

```cpp
std::optional<std::size_t> number_of_pages() const
```

The page count; nullopt for an open-ended count (see [`infinite()`](#infinite)).

### set_number_of_pages

```cpp
void set_number_of_pages(std::optional<std::size_t> number_of_pages)
```

Sets the page count; nullopt is an open-ended count (see [`infinite()`](#infinite)). Clamps [selected_index()](#selected_index) into the new range, firing [on_selection_changed()](#on_selection_changed) if that moves it.

### set_number_of_pages

```cpp
template <std::signed_integral I>
void set_number_of_pages(I number_of_pages)
```

A count given as a signed number, which must not be negative. Pass std::nullopt for an open-ended count.

### infinite

```cpp
bool infinite() const
```

Whether the page count is open-ended: Next never hides and the pip list grows as the selection advances.

### selected_index

```cpp
std::size_t selected_index() const
```

The current page, 0-based; 0 by default and with no pages.

### set_selected_index

```cpp
void set_selected_index(std::size_t index)
```

Selects page `index`, clamped to [0, [number_of_pages()](#number_of_pages)-1], or to 0 with no pages. With an open-ended count there is no upper limit. Does nothing, and fires nothing, if the page is already selected.

### max_visible_pips

```cpp
std::size_t max_visible_pips() const
```

The most pips shown at once; 5 by default.

### set_max_visible_pips

```cpp
void set_max_visible_pips(std::size_t max_visible_pips)
```

Sets how many pips are shown at once. The shown range of pages keeps the selection roughly centered and stops at the ends, with no smooth scrolling. Changes the control's measured size.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

A fixed-size strip: `min(max_visible_pips, number_of_pages)` pip slots, each 12 DIPs along the main axis by 24 across it, plus a 24x24 DIP square for each button that is not Collapsed, in either orientation. Hover never changes it, only the properties above do.

### pointer_override

```cpp
bool pointer_override(const PointerEvent& e) override
```

A click on a pip selects its page. A click on a button steps as [`PipsPagerWrapMode`](#pipspagerwrapmode) allows.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the visible dots (the selected one larger), the button glyphs and the focus ring.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

### focus_changed

```cpp
void focus_changed(bool focused) override
```

Focus also reveals VisibleOnPointerOver buttons.

### key_override

```cpp
bool key_override(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

Arrow keys along the axis step the selection, following [`PipsPagerWrapMode`](#pipspagerwrapmode). Home/End jump to the first/last page. End does nothing with an open-ended count.

## Enumerations

### PipsPagerButtonVisibility

```cpp
enum class PipsPagerButtonVisibility
```

How a [PipsPager](#uipipspager) shows its previous or next button.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Visible` | Shown whenever it has somewhere to go. |
| `VisibleOnPointerOver` | Shown only while the pointer is over the pager or it has focus; its slot is reserved either way. |
| `Collapsed` | Not shown and takes no space (the default). |

### PipsPagerWrapMode

```cpp
enum class PipsPagerWrapMode
```

What a [PipsPager](#uipipspager)'s previous/next buttons and arrow keys do at the ends.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `None` | Stop at the first/last page; the button at that edge hides (the default). |
| `Wrap` | Next from the last page goes to the first, Previous from the first to the last. |
